policy: A cohort manifest attests the collection context that assessment rows cannot carry by themselves (docs/PHASE-3-FINDINGS.md). `build_comparison` refuses to compare rows without the operator_controlled_single_run attestation. Exclusions are recorded targets, not findings: `basis` says how far the review went, `reason` says what it found. Robots and discovery entries are dated evidence of how each origin was approached; contact evidence stays in the local discovery registry and is never published.

collection.description: One serial, operator-invoked run of `mrf-honest scorecard` per target under the default retrieval policy: identified User-Agent with a contact address, HTTPS only, conditional revalidation against the verified cache, retry backoff, and the default 1 GiB decoded-size ceiling. One bounded GET per file, with a pause between requests. An earlier same-day pass under a lower 500 MB ceiling was superseded by this run; its rows remain in the operator registry and fall outside this cohort's retrieval-policy scope.
